lines.text: Moses says to appoint judges and officials in every town, who must not accept a bribe, which blinds the eyes of the wise.
Moses forbids a wooden Asherah pole beside the altar and a sacred pillar, and forbids sacrificing a flawed ox or sheep.
For worshiping other gods, a person is stoned at the gates only after thorough investigation and the testimony of twelve witnesses.
A case too difficult for the town goes to the Levitical priests and the judge at the place the LORD will choose.
The king must be chosen by the elders of Israel, avoid many horses and wives, and write a copy of the instruction.

wrong_details.wrong: chosen by the elders of Israel
wrong_details.true: chosen by the LORD their God
